title: MRJ-Agent: An Effective Jailbreak Agent for Multi-Round Dialogue
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing an adversarial red-teaming agent to conduct multi-round jailbreak attacks on LLMs. While it mentions the goal of preventing 'unethical' reactions and uses a judge template based on safety policies, the study is a technical investigation of security robustness (attack success rates) rather than an evaluation of moral reasoning, ethical frameworks, or religion.
